newsitem.title: USA: RISCORP buys Alabama self-insurance fund.
newsitem.headline: RISCORP buys Alabama self-insurance fund.

text.p: RISCORP Inc said Monday it has acquired the workers' compensation self-insurance fund sponsored by the Occupational Safety Association of Alabama.

The acquisition will add more than $40 million in at-risk premium to the company and nearly 2,000 policyholders, making it the largest at-risk managed workers' compensation carrier in the state, the company said.
Under the terms of the agreement, RISCORP, through one of its insurance subsidiaries, will assume all contracts of coverage, claim reserves and escrow deposits of the fund, effective September 1.
